analyzers.finding: Neural detector score +2.4 over 3 window(s) of 4 s.

analyzers.name: prosody
analyzers.finding: Prosody: pitch range much lower than real speech; moment-to-moment pitch movement lower than real speech; loudness roughness (shimmer) lower than real speech; pitch roughness (jitter) typical of real speech.

limitations: Segments 2–3 score much higher than segment 1, which could mean a splice. This is a lead to check, not proof.
This model has not been validated on every commercial voice generator.
A single 'likely synthetic' result is not proof on its own. Corroborate it with the source and context.
